agent_activity_daily_session_key_hash_ch.name: agent_activity_daily_session_key_hash_check
agent_activity_daily_session_key_hash_ch.value:
length("daily_session_key") = 71
        and substr("daily_session_key", 1, 7) = 'sha256:'
        and substr("daily_session_key", 8) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        and "expires_at_ms" >= "created_at_ms"

agent_activity_digests_status_check.name: agent_activity_digests_status_check
agent_activity_digests_status_check.value:
("status" = 'pending' and "summary" is null and "failure_reason" is null)
        or ("status" = 'completed' and "summary" is not null and "failure_reason" is null)
        or ("status" = 'failed' and "summary" is null and "failure_reason" is not null)

agent_activity_events_payload_hash_check.name: agent_activity_events_payload_hash_check
agent_activity_events_payload_hash_check.value:
length("canonical_payload_hash") = 71
        and substr("canonical_payload_hash", 1, 7) = 'sha256:'
        and substr("canonical_payload_hash", 8) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'

center_agent_memory_subjects_member_shap.name: center_agent_memory_subjects_member_shape_check
center_agent_memory_subjects_member_shap.value:
("subject_kind" != 'member')
        or (
          "member_user_id" is not null
          and "zep_user_id" is not null
          and "zep_graph_id" is null
        )

center_agent_memory_subjects_org_shape_c.name: center_agent_memory_subjects_org_shape_check
center_agent_memory_subjects_org_shape_c.value:
("subject_kind" != 'organization')
        or (
          "member_id" is null
          and "member_user_id" is null
          and "zep_user_id" is null
          and "zep_graph_id" is not null
        )

connector_connections_name_format_check.name: connector_connections_name_format_check
connector_connections_name_format_check.value: length("connection_name") between 1 and 64 and "connection_name" glob '[A-Za-z0-9]*' and "connection_name" not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'

connector_connections_disconnected_at_va.name: connector_connections_disconnected_at_valid_check
connector_connections_disconnected_at_va.value: ("status" = 'disconnected' and "disconnected_at_ms" is not null) or ("status" != 'disconnected' and "disconnected_at_ms" is null)

projects_slug_shape_check.name: projects_slug_shape_check
projects_slug_shape_check.value:
length("slug") > 0
        and "slug" = lower("slug")
        and "slug" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
        and "slug" not like '-%'
        and "slug" not like '%-'
        and "slug" not like '%--%'

projects_repository_fingerprint_shape_ch.name: projects_repository_fingerprint_shape_check
projects_repository_fingerprint_shape_ch.value:
"repository_fingerprint" is null or (
        length("repository_fingerprint") = 71
        and substr("repository_fingerprint", 1, 7) = 'sha256:'
        and substr("repository_fingerprint", 8) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      )

routine_runs_finished_at_valid_check.name: routine_runs_finished_at_valid_check
routine_runs_finished_at_valid_check.value: "finished_at_ms" is null or "started_at_ms" is null or "finished_at_ms" >= "started_at_ms"

routines_status_next_due_check.name: routines_status_next_due_check
routines_status_next_due_check.value: ("status" = 'enabled' and "next_due_at" is not null) or ("status" = 'paused' and "next_due_at" is null)

openMeldDaemon_agent_profile_bindings_ho.name: openMeldDaemon_agent_profile_bindings_hosted_identity_check
openMeldDaemon_agent_profile_bindings_ho.value: (("runtime_kind" = 'openmeld_service' and "hosted_runtime_identity_json" is null) or ("runtime_kind" = 'hosted_center_agent' and "hosted_runtime_identity_json" is not null and json_valid("hosted_runtime_identity_json")))

openMeldDaemon_agent_profile_bindings_li.name: openMeldDaemon_agent_profile_bindings_lifecycle_check
openMeldDaemon_agent_profile_bindings_li.value: (("binding_state" = 'enabled_primary' and "disabled_at_ms" is null) or ("binding_state" = 'disabled_historical' and "disabled_at_ms" is not null))

openmeld_profiles_profile_handle_check.name: openmeld_profiles_profile_handle_check
openmeld_profiles_profile_handle_check.value: length(trim("profile_handle")) > 0 and "profile_handle" not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*' and substr(trim("profile_handle"), 1, 1) glob '[A-Za-z0-9]' and length(trim("profile_handle")) <= 128

openmeld_profiles_profile_id_format_chec.name: openmeld_profiles_profile_id_format_check
openmeld_profiles_profile_id_format_chec.value: ( ("profile_kind" = 'agent' and length("profile_id") = 40 and substr("profile_id", 1, 4) = 'agt_' and length(substr("profile_id", 5)) = 36 and substr("profile_id", 5) not glob '*[^0-9a-f-]*' and length(replace(substr("profile_id", 5), '-', '')) = 32 and substr(substr("profile_id", 5), 9, 1) = '-' and substr(substr("profile_id", 5), 14, 1) = '-' and substr(substr("profile_id", 5), 19, 1) = '-' and substr(substr("profile_id", 5), 24, 1) = '-') or ("profile_kind" in ('human', 'system') and length("profile_id") = 36 and "profile_id" not glob '*[^0-9a-f-]*' and length(replace("profile_id", '-', '')) = 32 and substr("profile_id", 9, 1) = '-' and substr("profile_id", 14, 1) = '-' and substr("profile_id", 19, 1) = '-' and substr("profile_id", 24, 1) = '-') )

openmeld_profiles_organization_profile_k.name: openmeld_profiles_organization_profile_kind_check
openmeld_profiles_organization_profile_k.value: (("profile_kind" = 'agent' and "organization_id" is not null) or ("profile_kind" in ('human', 'system') and "organization_id" is null))
